- **Scope:** The file lists 40 purchase orders (PO-10001 to PO-10040) from 30 distinct suppliers. Together they total about **514,493.55**. Individual orders range from 469.92 to 33,798.86.
- **Status:** 38 orders are **received**, 1 is **open** (PO-10015, 4,951.80) and 1 is **cancelled** (PO-10028, 14,896.30).
- **Spend by cost centre:** CC-MKT is highest at 134,805.58 across 9 orders. CC-LOG follows at 117,487.31, then CC-FAC at 84,196.45, CC-IT at 72,196.48, CC-RND at 65,213.76 and CC-OPS at 40,593.97. The largest single order is PO-10011 (CC-IT, SUP-043, 33,798.86).
